item.title: Bulletin updated at 02:20 HKT 29/May/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will bring showers and thunderstorms to the coast of Guangdong today. With the trough of low pressure moving into the northern part of the South China Sea, showers will ease off over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, a strong easterly airstream will affect the region. A southwesterly airstream is expected to establish over the coast of southern China gradually early next week, bringing hot and showery weather to the region. Another trough of low pressure will edge closer to southern China midweek next week.
